question:
Rakhi purchased a basket, a wallet and a belt. She got discounts of 5%, 8% and 10% on the basket, the wallet and the belt respectively on their respective marked prices of ₹80, ₹150 and ₹350. How much amount (int) did she pay in total?

(CPO 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 529

Amount paid for basket = 80 × \(\frac{19}{20}\) = ₹76

Amount paid for wallet = 150 × \(\frac{23}{25}\) = ₹138

Amount paid for belt = 350 × \(\frac{9}{10}\) = ₹315 

.:. Total amount paid by her 
= 76 + 138 + 315 
= ₹529

(СРО 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 529 है। 

टोकरी के लिए दी गई राशि=  80 × \(\frac{19}{20}\) = ₹76

पर्स के लिए दी गई राशि =  150 × \(\frac{23}{25}\) = ₹138

बेल्ट के लिए दी गई राशि =  350 × \(\frac{9}{10}\) = ₹315 

.:. उसके द्वारा दी गई राशि
= 76 + 138 + 315 
= ₹529

question:
Vikram allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on the marked price of a book, which is equal to a single discount of ₹252. Then how much profit will Vikram get, on that book, if the cost price is ₹600?

(CHSL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. ₹48.

Single discount equivalent to 20% and 10%
Discount % = 20 + 10 – \(\frac{20 × 10}{100}\)
= 28% 
28% →×9 →₹252 

MP = 100% →×9 → ₹900 
SP = 900 - 252 = ₹648
Profit = 648-600 = ₹48
question_hi:

(CHSL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात  ₹48 है।  

20% और 10% के बराबर एकल छूट
छूट% = 20 + 10 –\(\frac{20 × 10}{100}\)
= 28% 
28% →×9 →₹252 

MP = 100% →×9 → ₹900 
SP = 900 - 252 = ₹648
लाभ = 648-600 = ₹48

question:
A shopkeeper offers the following discount schemes for the purchase of his goods. Find the scheme which has the maximum discount.

(i) Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%
(ii) Discount of 10%
(iii) Buy 8 and get 4 free
(iv) Buy 9 and get 6 free

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. (iv).

I→ 20 + 10 –(\(\frac{20 × 10}{100}\))
= 30 - 2 = 28%
II → 10% 
III → \(\frac{4}{12}\) ×100% = 33.33% 
IV → \(\frac{6}{15}\) ×100% = 40% 
Scheme IV has maximum discount of 40%
